mapper.select: INSERT INTO hashtag (name) VALUES (#{name}) ON CONFLICT (name) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name RETURNING hashtag_id, name
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post_hashtag (post_id, hashtag_id) VALUES (#{postId}, #{hashtagId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT h.name FROM hashtag h JOIN post_hashtag ph ON h.hashtag_id = ph.hashtag_id WHERE ph.post_id = #{postId}
